16.en: Please don’t touch that. There is a system to all of this. Now, what do you need? I’m very busy. The data is not wrong. 10,000 units. Delivery within the decade. What is it you said? I’m very busy. Collation is underway. Please don’t touch that.

28.en: Born and trained on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.0g60Fj0fRMDfzYGB]{Macharia}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vds8HRa533wcv1Pq]{Agira Chernov} is nearly the perfect @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.3TtxuCzt0nNV1ysj]{Administratum} clerk: armed with a photographic memory and a mind for sticking to bureaucratic procedure. Agira has the aptitude to rise higher within the Administratum, but in her years of service, she has sworn away from moving beyond the rank of clerk. She tried it once and found it infuriating and understimulating. Her brusque demeanour tends to push others away, so she shuffled from post to post as higher officials tired of her lack of decorum. Eventually, she found her way back to the datavaults.

32.en: Her natural eidetic memory has filled her head with incalculable amounts of data, facts, and jumbles of cyphers and numbers. But her photographic memory does not work on people. She recognises faces, but putting names to them is often challenging if she does not see them in a dataslate or voxcaster. She can recall precisely how many tonnes of recaf were delivered to the hive over the past six months, but recalling the name of an assistant clerk she saw earlier that day would be a significant challenge to her.

36.en: Not all information @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vds8HRa533wcv1Pq]{Agira} has stored within her photographic memory is something she rightfully should have seen. After digging through datavaults and pulling on hidden threads, she encountered many forbidden lores. Naturally, she could not help but commit it to memory before it was too late. Despite destroying all traces of what she found, she is haunted by nightmares of what is now etched into her memory for good. So far, she has managed to evade any sort of Inquisitorial investigation but fears it is only a matter of time before someone comes digging around in her head for her darkest secrets.

40.en: She is terrified of psykers, knowing that her memory contains heretical texts they might be able to read with their unnatural abilities. She fears being mind-wiped, a fate for her almost worse than death — the decades of information gathered in her head represent her identity and the only thing she truly knows and loves.

44.en: To overcome the noise of her brain and all the information rattling within it, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vds8HRa533wcv1Pq]{Agira} medicates herself to sleep each night with the hardest amasec she can afford. This behaviour leaves her vulnerable and less effective outside her work. At nearly fifty years old, her age is starting to show on her gaunt face. The years have been kind, but she makes no attempts to care for her looks — they do not matter to the books, scrolls, and dataslates, so neither do they matter to her.

48.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vds8HRa533wcv1Pq]{Agira} can be placed in any large @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.3TtxuCzt0nNV1ysj]{Administratum} facility or datavault across the Macharian Sector.

60.en: It is by no means a formal request, but @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vds8HRa533wcv1Pq]{Agira} appreciates a quality bottle of amasec from time to time, especially one better than she can typically afford.

68.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vds8HRa533wcv1Pq]{Agira} recently requested some logs from a datavault related to something she should not have seen, but her access was denied. She needs someone to gain access and strike her request from the record, paranoid that someone has noticed her snooping around.

76.en: A Tech-Priest recently visited her datavault, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vds8HRa533wcv1Pq]{Agira} believes they altered some existing records. What is on paper does not match what is in her head. She asks the characters to track this Tech-Priest down and discover what they have been up to.

92.en: At a basic level of trust, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vds8HRa533wcv1Pq]{Agira} gives the characters access to search the records of her assigned datavault and anything legitimate she holds in her head.

100.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vds8HRa533wcv1Pq]{Agira} knows that data is valuable, and so is its destruction. At a high level of trust, she offers to destroy information or alter records for the characters or their Patron.

108.en: With her greatest trust, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vds8HRa533wcv1Pq]{Agira} shares the horrific information she holds in her head, the secrets she should not know.
